title: Intermediate machine configurations
statement: Let $P$ be a program with $m$ work tapes and control states of the form $(\lambda,\phi)$, let $W$ be an integer, and let $c$ be a configuration on input $x$. The configuration is intermediate if every state currently represented by $c$ is not a call state of $P$, and every work-tape head position lies between $-1$ and $W$, inclusive.
